summary: T10 implementation correctly centralizes change recording at the domain-service transaction boundary. All acceptance criteria are met for in-scope mutations. MCP internal handlers bypassing EventService is a T12 concern, not a T10 defect.
follow_up: MCP internal handlers (create_event, update_event, commit_delete_intent) in mcp_internal.rs bypass EventService and do not record DAV changes — this is a T12 concern
DAV create compensation path (http.rs:683) records 2 changes (created + deleted) when create_resource fails — this is a T07 concern
important_context: T10 scope is 'Base event create/update/delete paths' through the domain service
T12 scope is 'Inventory all mutation entry points and route/instrument each through the recorder'
